-- A primary key is unique and never NULL.
SELECT order_id, count(*) AS copies
FROM bronze.orders
GROUP BY order_id
HAVING count(*) > 1 OR order_id IS NULL;

-- Negative amounts are refunds; zero amounts are suspicious.
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(amount AS DOUBLE) < 0) AS refunds,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(amount AS DOUBLE) = 0) AS zero_amounts
FROM bronze.orders;

import polars as pl

orders = pl.DataFrame(query("SELECT customer_id, CAST(amount AS DOUBLE) AS amount FROM bronze.orders")).lazy()
orders.group_by("customer_id").agg(pl.col("amount").sum().alias("revenue")).sort("revenue", descending=True)

rows = query("SELECT count(*) AS n FROM bronze.orders")
print(f"{rows[0]['n']} orders")
